title: Jesus' Teaching in the Temple at the Feast of Tabernacles
description: In the middle of the Feast of Tabernacles, Jesus goes up to the temple and begins to teach. The Jews are amazed at his teaching, and Jesus explains that his teaching is from the one who sent him. He confronts them with their attempt to kill him, and defends his healing on the Sabbath by pointing to circumcision. On the last great day of the feast, he cries out the promise of living water to anyone who thirsts – a word about the Spirit. The crowd is divided: some believe he is the prophet or the Messiah, while others reject him because he is from Galilee. The chief priests and Pharisees send guards to arrest him, but the guards return empty-handed, captivated by his speech. Nicodemus speaks up on his behalf, reminding them that the law requires hearing a man before judging him.
